sections.introduction: Maha Bhringraj Thailam (Oil) is an ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from the mixture of herbs. This formulation is known to treat ailments related to head, hair, neck, ear and eyes.
sections.ingredients:
Ksheera – Cow Milk 
 Bhirngaraja – Eclipta alba (4944 grams) 
 Taila – sesame oil (1536 grams) 

 All following ingredients up to 48 grams:- 

 Gairika – Red ochre 
 Bala – Sida cordifolia 
 Daru Haridra – Berberis aristata 
 Turmeric – Curcuma longa 
 Nagakeshara – Mesua feera 
 Manjishta – Rubia cordifolia 
 Padmaka – Prunus puddum 
 Lodhra – Symplocos racemosa 
 Prapaundarika – Nelumbo nucifera 
 Gopi – Hemidesmus indicus 
 Chandana – Santalum album 
 Priyangu – Callicarpa macrophylla 
 Yashtimadhu – Glycyrrhiza glabra 

 Method of Preparation 

 First take the Bhirngaraja and taila in a container. 
 Take all other herbal ingredients and grindin milk to form kalka. 
 Now mix kalka with bhringaraja and taila. 
 Cook this to bring out the taila, after once taila seen, just strain the formulation and pour in a container.
sections.dose:
This is used as hair oil for massage. 
 Can pour oil drops into nostrils.
sections.indications:
Hail fall 
 Headache 
 Ear ache 
 Alopecia 
 Premature baldness 
 Spilt end hair problem 
 Eyes and ear problems
sections.contraindications:
No contraindications, safe to use. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

Maha Bhringraj Thailam (Oil) – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference – Bhaishajya Ratnavali Kshudra Roga Chikitsa 
 Introduction 
 Maha Bhringraj Thailam (Oil) is an ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from the mixture of herbs. This formulation is known to treat ailments related to head, hair, neck, ear and eyes. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Ksheera – Cow Milk 
 Bhirngaraja – Eclipta alba (4944 grams) 
 Taila – sesame oil (1536 grams) 
 
 All following ingredients up to 48 grams:- 
 
 Gairika – Red ochre 
 Bala – Sida cordifolia 
 Daru Haridra – Berberis aristata 
 Turmeric – Curcuma longa 
 Nagakeshara – Mesua feera 
 Manjishta – Rubia cordifolia 
 Padmaka – Prunus puddum 
 Lodhra – Symplocos racemosa 
 Prapaundarika – Nelumbo nucifera 
 Gopi – Hemidesmus indicus 
 Chandana – Santalum album 
 Priyangu – Callicarpa macrophylla 
 Yashtimadhu – Glycyrrhiza glabra 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 First take the Bhirngaraja and taila in a container. 
 Take all other herbal ingredients and grindin milk to form kalka. 
 Now mix kalka with bhringaraja and taila. 
 Cook this to bring out the taila, after once taila seen, just strain the formulation and pour in a container. 
 
 Dose 
 
 This is used as hair oil for massage. 
 Can pour oil drops into nostrils. 
 
 Indications 
 
 Hail fall 
 Headache 
 Ear ache 
 Alopecia 
 Premature baldness 
 Spilt end hair problem 
 Eyes and ear problems 
 
 Contraindications 
 No contraindications, safe to use. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
